description: Return a capture URL the user pastes into their webhook provider (Stripe/GitHub/etc.), plus the web app URL for browsing captures. Works the same before and after claiming. Omit ids to use the claimed or only endpoint; pass projectId + endpointId to target a specific one.

endpointId.description: Opaque endpoint id; omit to auto-pick the claimed or only endpoint.

projectId.description: Opaque project id; omit to auto-pick the claimed or only project.

name: get_capture_url
title: Get capture URL
